description:
## [1.0.1](https://github.com/nullroute3/morphe-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1) (2026-11-12)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Pad patched isPremiumUser reads with LoadConstTrue instead of Unreachable ([eabb2ea](https://github.com/nullroute3/morphe-patches/commit/eabb2ea740d2d3a49fcc097cd3e33ad42a58efc4))

patches.name: Disable analytics collection
patches.description: Sets the Firebase Analytics collection flags to false in the manifest

patches.name: Disable expo-updates
patches.description: Stops the app from downloading OTA JS bundles over the embedded one. Required for patches that change the JS bundle.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Forces isPremiumUserSelector and the isPremiumUser state reads to true, which unlocks the Premium features and removes the paywalls.
